svg.title: Two Keyholders
svg.desc: Sketch in perspective: a long wall with one hatched door in it. At the door, a mannequin turns a key in the lock. From the right, a second mannequin walks up holding its own key out, ready to use it. The wall and door are the shared system from the pattern's context: something a group depends on, with one way in. The door is admin access, the focus. Each key is full access, and each figure is a keyholder. Two keys for one door is the first half of the solution: at least two people can get in, without needing each other. The second figure arriving with its own key out, about to take a turn, is the second half: both keyholders use their access regularly. The consequence is that the door still opens whichever of them is away. The metaphor: admin access as the key to a shared building, with a second key cut and carried, not left in a drawer.
